description: This PHP class 'DataValidations' is part of the PhpSpreadsheet library and handles parsing and loading data validation rules from XML elements in XLSX worksheets. It processes various validation constraints, cell ranges, and their configuration to set data validation rules on spreadsheet cells.

classes.name: DataValidations
classes.description: A class responsible for loading and interpreting data validation rules from XML elements in an XLSX worksheet, and applying these rules to spreadsheet cells.

methods.name: loadDataValidations
methods.description: Parses data validation rules from a SimpleXMLElement representing a worksheet and applies them to the specified Spreadsheet object.
